source.text: שִׁמְע֞וּ אֶת־הַדָּבָ֣ר הַזֶּ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבֶּ֧ר יְהוָ֛ה עֲלֵיכֶ֖ם בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל עַ֚ל כָּל־הַמִּשְׁפָּחָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֧ר הֶעֱלֵ֛יתִי מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרַ֖יִם לֵאמֹֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: Hear this word which Yahweh has spoken against you, sons of Israel, against the whole clan which I brought up from [the] land of Egypt, saying:

en.L: Hear this word that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has spoken against you, {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel, \q against the whole clan \q that I brought up from the land of Egypt, saying:
en.B: Hear this word that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has spoken against you, {{gender:people|sons}} of Israel, \q against the whole family \q that I brought up from the land of Egypt:
en.R: People of Israel, listen to this message that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has spoken against you, \q against the whole family \q that I brought out of the land of Egypt:

es.L: {{plural_you:Oigan|Oíd}} esta palabra que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha hablado contra {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, hijos de Israel, \q contra todo el clan \q que hice subir de la tierra de Egipto, diciendo:
es.B: {{plural_you:Escuchen|Escuchad}} esta palabra que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha pronunciado contra {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, israelitas, \q contra toda la familia \q que hice subir de la tierra de Egipto:
es.R: Pueblo de Israel, {{plural_you:escuchen|escuchad}} este mensaje que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha dicho contra {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, \q contra toda la familia \q que yo saqué de la tierra de Egipto:

fr.L: Écoutez cette parole que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a prononcée contre vous, {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël, \q contre tout le clan \q que j’ai fait monter du pays d’Égypte, en disant :
fr.B: Écoutez cette parole que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a prononcée contre vous, {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}}, \q contre toute la famille \q que j’ai fait monter du pays d’Égypte :
fr.R: {{gender:Israélites|Fils d’Israël}}, écoutez ce message que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a prononcé contre vous, \q contre toute la famille \q que j’ai fait sortir du pays d’Égypte :

sw.L: Sikieni neno hili ambalo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amelinena juu yenu, enyi wana wa Israeli, \q juu ya ukoo wote \q niliouleta kutoka nchi ya Misri, kusema:
sw.B: Sikilizeni neno hili ambalo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amesema dhidi yenu, enyi wana wa Israeli, \q dhidi ya jamaa yote \q niliyoileta kutoka nchi ya Misri:
sw.R: Enyi watu wa Israeli, sikilizeni ujumbe huu ambao {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amesema dhidi yenu, \q dhidi ya jamaa yote \q niliyoitoa katika nchi ya Misri:

vi.L: Hãy nghe lời này mà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã phán nghịch cùng các ngươi, hỡi con cái Y-sơ-ra-ên, \q nghịch cùng cả gia tộc \q mà {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã đem lên khỏi đất Ai Cập, rằng:
vi.B: Hãy nghe lời này mà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã phán nghịch cùng các ngươi, hỡi dân Y-sơ-ra-ên, \q nghịch cùng cả gia đình \q mà {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã đem lên khỏi đất Ai Cập:
vi.R: Hỡi dân Y-sơ-ra-ên, hãy nghe sứ điệp này mà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã phán nghịch cùng các ngươi, \q nghịch cùng cả gia đình \q mà {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã đem ra khỏi đất Ai Cập:

ko.L: {{gender:이스라엘 자손|이스라엘의 아들들}}아, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 너희를 두고 하신 이 말씀을 들어라. \q 내가 이집트 땅에서 이끌어 올린 \q 온 족속을 두고 [하신 말씀이다]. 그분께서 말씀하셨다.
ko.B: {{gender:이스라엘 백성|이스라엘의 아들들}}아, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 너희를 두고 하신 이 말씀을 들어라. \q 내가 이집트 땅에서 이끌어 올린 \q 온 집안을 두고 하신 말씀이다.
ko.R: 이스라엘 백성아, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 너희를 두고 하신 이 말씀을 들어라. \q 내가 이집트 땅에서 데리고 나온 \q 온 집안에게 하신 말씀이다.

pt.L: Ouçam esta palavra que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} falou contra vocês, filhos de Israel, \q contra todo o clã \q que eu fiz subir da terra do Egito, dizendo:
pt.B: Ouçam esta palavra que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} falou contra vocês, israelitas, \q contra toda a família \q que eu tirei da terra do Egito:
pt.R: Povo de Israel, escutem esta mensagem que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} falou contra vocês, \q contra toda a família \q que eu tirei da terra do Egito:

am.L: የእስራኤል ልጆች ሆይ፣ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} በእናንተ ላይ የተናገረውን ይህን ቃል ስሙ፤ \q [ይህም] በወገኑ ሁሉ ላይ፣ \q ከግብፅ ምድር ባወጣሁት ላይ [የተነገረ ነው]፤ እንዲህም ይላል፦
am.B: የእስራኤል ልጆች ሆይ፣ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} በእናንተ ላይ የተናገረውን ይህን ቃል ስሙ፤ \q ይህም በቤተሰቡ ሁሉ ላይ፣ \q ከግብፅ ምድር ባወጣሁት ላይ የተነገረ ነው፦
am.R: የእስራኤል ሕዝብ ሆይ፣ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} በእናንተ ላይ የተናገረውን ይህን መልእክት ስሙ፤ \q ይህም በቤተሰቡ ሁሉ ላይ፣ \q ከግብፅ ምድር ባወጣሁት ላይ የተነገረ ነው፦

hi.L: यह वचन सुनो जो {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने तुम्हारे विरुद्ध कहा है, हे {{gender:इस्राएल की सन्तान|इस्राएल के पुत्रो}}, \q उस सारे कुल के विरुद्ध \q जिसे मैं मिस्र देश से निकाल लाया, कि:
hi.B: यह वचन सुनो जो {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने तुम्हारे विरुद्ध कहा है, हे {{gender:इस्राएल के लोगो|इस्राएल के पुत्रो}}, \q उस सारे परिवार के विरुद्ध \q जिसे मैं मिस्र देश से निकाल लाया:
hi.R: हे इस्राएल के लोगो, यह संदेश सुनो जो {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने तुम्हारे विरुद्ध कहा है, \q उस सारे परिवार के विरुद्ध \q जिसे मैं मिस्र देश से निकाल लाया:

ru.L: Слушайте это слово, которое {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} сказал о вас, {{gender:дети Израиля|сыны Израиля}}, \q обо всём роде, \q который {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} вывел из земли Египта, говоря:
ru.B: Слушайте это слово, которое {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} изрёк против вас, {{gender:израильтяне|сыны Израиля}}, \q против всего рода, \q который {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} вывел из земли Египта:
ru.R: Народ Израиля, послушайте эту весть, которую {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} изрёк против вас, \q против всей семьи, \q которую {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} вывел из земли Египта:

ja.L: イスラエルの子らよ、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}があなたがたに対して語られたこの言葉を聞け。 \q すなわち、全氏族に対して、 \q わたしがエジプトの地から導き上った[全氏族に対して]、こう[語られた]。
ja.B: イスラエルの人々よ、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}があなたがたに対して語られたこの言葉を聞きなさい。 \q それは全氏族に対する言葉、 \q わたしがエジプトの地から導き上った民全体に対する言葉である。
ja.R: イスラエルの人々よ、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}があなたたちに対して語られたこの言葉を聞きなさい。 \q それは、民全体に向けられた言葉だ。 \q わたしがエジプトの地から連れ出した民全体に向けられた言葉だ。

uk.L: Слухайте це слово, яке {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} сказав проти вас, {{gender:діти|сини}} Ізраїля, \q проти всього роду, \q який {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} вивів із землі єгипетської, кажучи:
uk.B: Слухайте це слово, яке {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} сказав проти вас, {{gender:народе|сини}} Ізраїля, \q проти всієї родини, \q яку {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} вивів із єгипетської землі:
uk.R: Народе Ізраїля, слухайте це послання, яке {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} сказав проти вас, \q проти всієї родини, \q яку {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} вивів з Єгипту:

decisions.choice: the LORD has spoken ... that I brought up: the prophet's call to listen runs straight into the LORD's own words
decisions.reason: The verse begins with the prophet speaking of the LORD as "he" and ends with the LORD saying "I". Amos often moves between the two voices without a break; the message is the LORD's either way.

decisions.choice: the whole clan: all Israel, the whole people the LORD brought out of Egypt
decisions.reason: The word means a clan or extended family. Here it covers the whole people that came out of Egypt, Judah as well as the northern kingdom, spoken of as one family. Verse 2 uses the same word for "all the clans of the earth".

decisions.choice: clan (L), family (B, R); saying (L only)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "family", to match "all the families of the earth" in verse 2 at those levels. The Hebrew ends with "saying", which Literal keeps; the other levels let the colon do its work.

decisions.choice: "hijos de Israel" (L), "israelitas" (B), "Pueblo de Israel" (R), no gender span; "Oigan / Escuchen la palabra"
decisions.reason: The sons of Israel as the terms note sets; "Hear the word of the LORD" as the Spanish of Isaiah and Kings (L "Oigan", B and R "Escuchen"), with plural_you.

decisions.choice: "Écoutez cette parole" (L, B); "écoutez ce message" (R)
decisions.reason: The call that opens chapters 3, 4 and 5 keeps one wording at each level, as the French prophets' "Écoutez la parole du SEIGNEUR" (L, B) and "Écoutez le message du SEIGNEUR" (R).

decisions.choice: "Sikieni neno hili" (L); "Sikilizeni neno hili" (B); "sikilizeni ujumbe huu" (R)
decisions.reason: As "Hear the word of the LORD" in the Isaiah and Jeremiah blocks.

decisions.choice: "Ta" for the LORD after "CHÚA đã phán"
decisions.reason: The prophet's call to listen runs straight into the LORD's own words (meaning decision); Vietnamese keeps the switch to "Ta" in the same sentence, as the Hebrew does.

decisions.choice: The prophet's call keeps -시- for God ("{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 … 하신 말씀"), and the relative clause is already God's first person ("내가 … 이끌어 올린")
decisions.reason: The Hebrew runs the prophet's call straight into God's own words, as the meaning decision says; Korean keeps both voices rather than smoothing them.

decisions.choice: filhos de Israel (L), israelitas (B), no gender setting
decisions.reason: As at 2:11: "filhos" and "israelitas" already include women, so the English gender span has no second Portuguese wording.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun spans in Amharic
decisions.reason: The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the English spans on the LORD's pronouns in this chapter have no Amharic counterpart.

decisions.choice: the call to hear is one sentence ending in "ባወጣሁት" (that I brought up), with no quotation marks
decisions.reason: As the meaning decision says, the prophet's words run straight into the LORD's own; Amharic keeps the shift of person inside the relative clause, and like the English sets no speech marks around the oracle that follows.

decisions.choice: कुल (L); परिवार (B, R)
decisions.reason: The clan is all Israel (meaning decision m2); Balanced and Readable say परिवार to match "all the families of the earth" in verse 2, as the English does. The gender setting on "sons of Israel" is as in 2:11.

decisions.choice: {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} вывел
decisions.reason: The prophet's call runs straight into the LORD's own words (meaning decision); God's first-person pronouns carry the deity_pronoun setting in Amos, mid-sentence "я" included, as in Isaiah.

decisions.choice: shim'u "聞け" (L), "聞きなさい" (B, R); the prophet's voice ("主が語られた", with the respect form) runs straight into God's "わたしが…導き上った" without a quotation mark, as the Hebrew does (m1).
alternatives: add a quotation mark before "わたしが"
decisions.reason: The ISA formula and command rules; the English has no quotation here either.

decisions.choice: mishpachah "氏族" (L, B), "民全体" (R), matching "地のすべての氏族" (Genesis 12:3) in the next verse.
alternatives: "家族" (B, as the English B family)
decisions.reason: Amos echoes the promise to Abraham (3:2 m2), so the Genesis Japanese word is kept at L and B.

source.text: רַ֚ק אֶתְכֶ֣ם יָדַ֔עְתִּי מִכֹּ֖ל מִשְׁפְּח֣וֹת הָאֲדָמָ֑ה עַל־כֵּן֙ אֶפְקֹ֣ד עֲלֵיכֶ֔ם אֵ֖ת כָּל־עֲוֺנֹֽתֵיכֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Only you I have known from all [the] clans of the earth; therefore I will visit on you all your iniquities.

en.L: Only you have I known \q of all the clans of the earth; \q therefore I will visit on you \q all your iniquities.
en.B: You alone have I known \q out of all the families of the earth; \q that is why I will punish you \q for all your sins.
en.R: I chose only you to be {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} own \q out of all the families on earth. \q That is why I will punish you \q for all your sins.

es.L: Solo a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} he conocido \q de entre todos los clanes de la tierra; \q por tanto, {{plural_you:los|os}} castigaré \q por todas {{plural_you:sus iniquidades|vuestras iniquidades}}.
es.B: Solo a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} he conocido \q entre todas las familias de la tierra; \q por eso {{plural_you:los|os}} castigaré \q por todos {{plural_you:sus pecados|vuestros pecados}}.
es.R: Solo a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} los escogí para que fueran {{deity_pronoun:míos|Míos}} \q entre todas las familias de la tierra. \q Por eso {{plural_you:los|os}} castigaré \q por todos {{plural_you:sus pecados|vuestros pecados}}.

fr.L: Vous seuls, je [vous] ai connus \q de tous les clans de la terre ; \q c’est pourquoi je visiterai sur vous \q toutes vos fautes.
fr.B: C’est vous seuls que j’ai connus \q parmi toutes les familles de la terre ; \q c’est pourquoi je vous punirai \q pour tous vos péchés.
fr.R: Je n’ai choisi que vous pour être {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple \q parmi toutes les familles de la terre. \q C’est pourquoi je vous punirai \q pour tous vos péchés.

sw.L: Ni ninyi tu niliowajua \q kati ya koo zote za dunia; \q kwa hiyo nitawapatiliza \q maovu yenu yote.
sw.B: Ni ninyi peke yenu niliowajua \q kati ya jamaa zote za dunia; \q ndiyo sababu nitawaadhibu \q kwa dhambi zenu zote.
sw.R: Niliwachagua ninyi peke yenu kuwa watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} \q kati ya jamaa zote za duniani. \q Ndiyo sababu nitawaadhibu \q kwa dhambi zenu zote.

vi.L: Chỉ các ngươi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã biết \q trong mọi gia tộc trên đất; \q vì vậy {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ thăm phạt trên các ngươi \q mọi tội ác của các ngươi.
vi.B: Chỉ riêng các ngươi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã biết đến \q trong mọi gia tộc trên đất; \q vì thế {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ trừng phạt các ngươi \q về mọi tội lỗi của các ngươi.
vi.R: Trong mọi gia tộc trên đất, \q {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} chỉ chọn các ngươi làm dân riêng của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. \q Vì thế {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ trừng phạt các ngươi \q về mọi tội lỗi của các ngươi.

ko.L: 땅의 모든 족속 가운데 \q 내가 오직 너희만 알았다. \q 그러므로 내가 너희의 모든 죄악을 \q 너희에게 갚겠다.
ko.B: 땅의 모든 족속 가운데서 \q 내가 너희만을 알았다. \q 그러므로 내가 너희의 모든 죄를 \q 벌하겠다.
ko.R: 세상의 모든 민족 가운데서 \q 나는 너희만을 택하여 내 백성으로 삼았다. \q 그러므로 나는 너희가 지은 모든 죄를 \q 벌하겠다.

pt.L: Somente vocês eu conheci \q de todos os clãs da terra; \q por isso eu visitarei sobre vocês \q todas as suas iniquidades.
pt.B: Somente a vocês eu conheci \q entre todas as famílias da terra; \q por isso vou castigá-los \q por todos os seus pecados.
pt.R: Escolhi somente vocês para serem o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo \q entre todas as famílias da terra. \q Por isso vou castigar vocês \q por todos os seus pecados.

am.L: እናንተን ብቻ አወቅኩ፣ \q ከምድር ወገኖች ሁሉ፤ \q ስለዚህ በእናንተ ላይ \q በደላችሁን ሁሉ እጎበኛለሁ።

decisions.choice: only you have I known: the LORD chose Israel and bound himself to it
decisions.reason: "Know" here is the knowing of a close, chosen relationship, not knowledge of facts: the LORD "knew" Abraham, choosing him (Genesis 18:19), and "knew" Israel in the wilderness, caring for it (Hosea 13:5; compare Jeremiah 1:5). The LORD knows all nations, as chapters 1-2 show, but only Israel is his own.

decisions.choice: all the clans of the earth: the words of the promise to Abraham
decisions.reason: The phrase is the one used when God promised that "all the families of the earth" would be blessed through Abraham (Genesis 12:3; 28:14). Israel was chosen from among them.

decisions.choice: therefore I will punish you: being chosen makes Israel more accountable, not safe
decisions.reason: Amos's hearers would expect "therefore I will protect you". The LORD says the opposite: because he chose Israel, he will hold it to account for every wrong. The verb, often translated "visit", means to attend to someone, here to punish (Exodus 32:34; Hosea 1:4); it returns twice in verse 14.

decisions.choice: known (L, B), chose ... to be my own (R); iniquities (L), sins (B, R)
decisions.reason: Readable says what "known" means here (m1). "Iniquities" and "sins" follow the settled wording for this word.

decisions.choice: "[los] castigaré por" (L)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "visit on you" is said as "castigar" even at L, since Spanish "visitar" does not carry the sense of calling to account; the English L keeps "visit".

decisions.choice: "biết" (L); "biết đến" (B)
decisions.reason: "Know" here is the LORD choosing Israel and binding himself to it (meaning decision); Literal and Balanced keep the verb of knowing, and Readable says "chọn", as the English does.

decisions.choice: visitarei sobre vocês
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the old idiom "visitar ... sobre", which Portuguese Bibles have long used for this verb, so that the reader sees the word of 3:14; Balanced and Readable say "castigar" (m3).

decisions.choice: o meu povo
decisions.reason: Readable says "o meu povo" where the English says "my own", the plain Portuguese for a people God has chosen (m1).

decisions.choice: visit (paqad) "እጎበኛለሁ" (L), "እቀጣለሁ" (B, R); iniquities "በደል" (L), "ኃጢአት" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew "visit ... upon", which Amos takes up again in 3:14; Balanced and Readable say what the visit is, punishment, as the English levels do.

decisions.choice: जाना है (L, B); अपना होने के लिए चुना (R); अधर्म (L), पाप (B, R)
decisions.reason: "Known" here means chosen and bound to (meaning decision m1); Literal and Balanced keep the verb and Readable says what it means. Iniquity is अधर्म at Literal and पाप at Balanced and Readable.

decisions.choice: познал (L), знал (B), избрал (R); беззакония (L), грехи (B, R)
decisions.reason: Known means chosen and bound to (meaning decision); Literal keeps the verb, Readable says chose, as the English. Iniquity is "беззаконие" at Literal as the Pentateuch note.

decisions.choice: L and B put "地のすべての氏族の中から" first and "あなたがただけを知った" in the second line, the Hebrew order of the two lines reversed; R keeps the English order with an afterthought line. yada' "知った" (L, B), "選んで、わたしのものとした" (R); paqad 'al "罰する" (every level, as Hosea); 'avon "咎" (L, B), "罪" (R).
alternatives: "あなたがただけを、わたしは知った。地のすべての氏族の中から。" (L)
decisions.reason: Japanese puts the source phrase before the verb; "Genesis 12:3" wording 地のすべての氏族 / 地上のすべての家族 is kept for the allusion.

decisions.choice: a chain of questions (verses 3-8), each expecting "No": nothing happens without a cause
decisions.reason: Verses 3-6 ask seven questions, each describing an effect that does not happen without its cause: two travelers meet because they arranged it; a lion roars because it has prey; a trap springs because something is caught; a city trembles because the alarm is sounded; disaster strikes because the LORD sends it. The questions start with harmless pictures and grow more frightening. Verse 8 draws the conclusion: the prophet speaks because the LORD has spoken. It is Amos's answer to those who tell him to be silent (2:12; 7:12-13).

decisions.choice: met by appointment: arranged to meet at a set time and place
decisions.reason: The verb means to meet by agreement, at an appointed place (Exodus 25:22; Joshua 11:5). The Septuagint reads "unless they know each other". Some readers see in the two the LORD and his prophet, or the LORD and Israel, but the question is first of all a picture from daily life.

decisions.choice: two people (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says only "two"; Balanced and Readable add "people" for clear English.

decisions.choice: The questions of 3:3-6 as "…だろうか。…のに。" (each expecting "no"), with the question shown by だろうか rather than ？ where the second line completes it.
decisions.reason: Japanese marks the rhetorical question with だろうか; a ？ in the middle of the two-line question would split it.

decisions.reason: The word is used of a lion in its full strength, hunting its own prey (Ezekiel 19:3; Judges 14:5).

decisions.choice: utter its voice (L), growl (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the phrase used of the LORD in 1:2 ("utters his voice"), so the reader can see the link; Balanced and Readable say what a lion does.

decisions.choice: solta a sua voz
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the phrase used of the LORD in 1:2 ("solta a sua voz"), so the link stays visible, as the English does; Balanced and Readable say "rosna".

decisions.choice: roar "አገሣ" as 1:2; young lion (kefir) "ወጣት አንበሳ", not "ደቦል" (cub)
decisions.reason: The roar ties the questions back to 1:2 and forward to 3:8. A kefir hunts for itself, as the meaning decision says, so it is not called a cub.

decisions.choice: अपनी आवाज़ सुनाता है (L); गुर्राता है (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the phrase used of the LORD in 1:2 ("अपनी आवाज़ सुनाते हैं"), so the link with the roaring LORD can be seen (meaning decision m1); Balanced and Readable say what a lion does.

decisions.choice: 'aryeh "獅子" (L, B), "ライオン" (R); kefir "若獅子" (L, B), "若いライオン" (R), as ISA and Hosea.
decisions.reason: The prophetic animal words.

source.text: הֲתִפֹּ֤ל צִפּוֹר֙ עַל־פַּ֣ח הָאָ֔רֶץ וּמוֹקֵ֖שׁ אֵ֣ין לָ֑הּ הֲיַֽעֲלֶה־פַּח֙ מִן־הָ֣אֲדָמָ֔ה וְלָכ֖וֹד לֹ֥א יִלְכּֽוֹד׃

records.literal_gloss: Does fall a bird into a trap of the ground when a snare there is not for it? Does spring up a trap from the ground and surely catch not it catches?

en.L: Does a bird fall into a trap on the ground \q when there is no snare for it? \q Does a trap spring up from the ground \q when it has caught nothing at all?
en.B: Does a bird fall into a trap on the ground \q if no snare has been set for it? \q Does a trap spring up from the ground \q when it has caught nothing?
en.R: Does a bird get caught in a trap on the ground \q if no one has set a trap for it? \q Does a trap spring shut \q if it has caught nothing?

es.L: ¿Caerá el ave en la trampa en el suelo \q sin que haya lazo para ella? \q ¿Saltará la trampa del suelo \q sin haber atrapado nada?
es.B: ¿Cae un pájaro en una trampa en el suelo \q si nadie le ha puesto un lazo? \q ¿Salta del suelo una trampa \q cuando no ha atrapado nada?
es.R: ¿Queda atrapado un pájaro en una trampa en el suelo \q si nadie le ha puesto una trampa? \q ¿Se cierra de golpe una trampa \q si no ha atrapado nada?

fr.L: Un oiseau tombe-t-il dans un piège à terre \q quand il n’y a pas de filet pour lui ? \q Un piège se lève-t-il du sol \q sans avoir rien pris du tout ?
fr.B: Un oiseau tombe-t-il dans un piège posé au sol \q si aucun filet n’a été tendu pour lui ? \q Un piège se referme-t-il en sautant du sol \q quand il n’a rien pris ?
fr.R: Un oiseau se fait-il prendre dans un piège posé par terre \q si personne n’a tendu de piège pour lui ? \q Un piège se referme-t-il \q s’il n’a rien attrapé ?

sw.L: Je, ndege huanguka katika mtego ulio ardhini \q kama hakuna tanzi kwa ajili yake? \q Je, mtego hufyatuka kutoka ardhini \q usipokuwa umekamata kitu kabisa?
sw.B: Je, ndege huanguka katika mtego ulio ardhini \q kama hakuna aliyemtegea tanzi? \q Je, mtego hufyatuka kutoka ardhini \q usipokuwa umekamata kitu?
sw.R: Je, ndege hunaswa katika mtego ulio ardhini \q kama hakuna mtu aliyemtegea? \q Je, mtego hufyatuka na kufunga \q kama haukukamata chochote?

vi.L: Chim có sa vào bẫy trên đất \q khi không có lưới bẫy dành cho nó chăng? \q Bẫy có bật lên khỏi đất \q khi nó chẳng bắt được gì chăng?
vi.B: Chim có sa vào bẫy trên đất \q nếu không ai giăng lưới bắt nó không? \q Bẫy có bật lên khỏi đất \q khi chẳng bắt được gì không?
vi.R: Chim có bị mắc bẫy trên đất \q nếu không ai giăng bẫy bắt nó không? \q Bẫy có sập lại \q nếu nó chẳng bắt được gì không?

ko.L: 새가 덫이 놓이지 않았는데 \q 땅의 올무에 걸리겠느냐? \q 아무것도 잡히지 않았는데 \q 올무가 땅에서 튀어 오르겠느냐?
ko.B: 새를 잡으려고 덫을 놓지 않았는데 \q 새가 땅의 올무에 걸리겠느냐? \q 잡힌 것이 없는데 \q 올무가 땅에서 튀어 오르겠느냐?
ko.R: 아무도 덫을 놓지 않았는데 \q 새가 땅에 놓인 덫에 걸리겠느냐? \q 아무것도 걸리지 않았는데 \q 덫이 탁 닫히겠느냐?

pt.L: Cai uma ave numa armadilha no chão \q quando não há laço para ela? \q Salta uma armadilha do chão \q sem ter apanhado absolutamente nada?
pt.B: Será que um pássaro cai numa armadilha no chão \q se ninguém armou um laço para ele? \q Será que uma armadilha salta do chão \q sem ter apanhado nada?
pt.R: Será que um passarinho fica preso numa armadilha no chão \q se ninguém armou uma armadilha para ele? \q Será que uma armadilha se fecha \q se não pegou nada?

am.L: ወፍ በምድር ላይ ባለ ወጥመድ ትወድቃለችን፣ \q አሽክላ ካልተዘጋጀላት? \q ወጥመድስ ከምድር ይፈናጠራልን፣ \q ምንም ሳይዝ?
am.B: ወፍ በምድር ላይ ባለ ወጥመድ ትያዛለችን፣ \q አሽክላ ካልተጠመደላት? \q ወጥመድስ ከምድር ይነሣልን፣ \q ምንም ሳይዝ?
am.R: ወፍ በምድር ላይ ባለ ወጥመድ ትያዛለች? \q ማንም ወጥመድ ካልዘረጋላት? \q ወጥመድስ ይዘጋል? \q ምንም ካልያዘ?

hi.L: क्या पक्षी भूमि पर के फंदे में गिरता है \q जब उसके लिए कोई जाल न लगा हो? \q क्या फंदा भूमि से उछलता है \q जब उसने कुछ भी न पकड़ा हो?
hi.B: क्या कोई पक्षी भूमि पर लगे फंदे में गिरता है \q यदि उसके लिए जाल न बिछाया गया हो? \q क्या फंदा भूमि से उछल पड़ता है \q जब उसने कुछ न पकड़ा हो?
hi.R: क्या कोई पक्षी ज़मीन पर लगे फंदे में फँसता है \q यदि किसी ने उसके लिए फंदा न लगाया हो? \q क्या फंदा झटके से बंद हो जाता है \q यदि उसमें कुछ न फँसा हो?

ru.L: Разве падает птица в западню на земле, \q когда нет для неё силка? \q Разве поднимается западня с земли, \q когда ничего не поймала?
ru.B: Разве птица попадёт в западню на земле, \q если для неё не поставлен силок? \q Разве западня взлетит с земли, \q если ничего не поймала?
ru.R: Разве птица попадёт в ловушку на земле, \q если никто не поставил для неё ловушки? \q Разве ловушка захлопнется, \q если в неё ничего не попало?

ja.L: 鳥が地上のわなに落ちるだろうか。 \q 落とし網が仕掛けられていないのに。 \q わなが地から跳ね上がるだろうか。 \q 何一つ捕らえていないのに。
ja.B: 鳥が地上のわなに落ちるだろうか。 \q 落とし網が仕掛けられていないのに。 \q わなが地から跳ね上がるだろうか。 \q 何も捕らえていないのに。
ja.R: 鳥が地面のわなにかかるだろうか。 \q だれもわなを仕掛けていないのに。 \q わながばたんと閉じるだろうか。 \q 何もかかっていないのに。

uk.L: Чи впаде птах у пастку на землі, \q коли немає для нього сильця? \q Чи підскочить пастка з землі, \q коли вона зовсім нічого не впіймала?
uk.B: Чи впаде птах у пастку на землі, \q якщо для нього не поставили сильця? \q Чи підскочить пастка з землі, \q коли нічого не впіймала?
uk.R: Чи потрапить птах у пастку на землі, \q якщо ніхто не поставив на нього пастки? \q Чи закриється пастка, \q якщо нічого не впіймала?

decisions.choice: trap ... snare: two words for a bird trap
decisions.reason: The first word is a net or clap-trap; the second may be the snare itself, its trigger, or the bait. The point is plain: a bird is not caught unless a trap has been set.

decisions.choice: a trap that springs up from the ground: a net that snaps shut when the bird touches it
decisions.reason: A fowler's trap lay on the ground and sprang up and closed when a bird touched the trigger. It does not spring unless something has set it off. Amos's hearers would know such traps well, and the picture is a hint that Israel is already caught.

decisions.choice: pach "わな", moqesh "落とし網" (L, B), as Isaiah 8:14.
decisions.reason: Two words for two Hebrew words.

source.text: אִם־יִתָּקַ֤ע שׁוֹפָר֙ בְּעִ֔יר וְעָ֖ם לֹ֣א יֶחֱרָ֑דוּ אִם־תִּהְיֶ֤ה רָעָה֙ בְּעִ֔יר וַיהוָ֖ה לֹ֥א עָשָֽׂה׃

records.literal_gloss: Or is blown a trumpet in a city and [the] people not tremble? Or is there calamity in a city and Yahweh not has done [it]?

en.L: Is a trumpet blown in a city \q and the people do not tremble? \q Is there calamity in a city \q and {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has not done [it]?
en.B: If a ram's horn is blown in a city, \q do the people not tremble? \q If disaster comes to a city, \q has {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} not done it?
en.R: When a warning trumpet sounds in a city, \q are the people not afraid? \q When disaster comes to a city, \q is it not {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} who sent it?

es.L: ¿Se tocará la trompeta en la ciudad \q y no temblará el pueblo? \q ¿Habrá calamidad en una ciudad \q sin que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} la haya hecho?
es.B: Si se toca el cuerno de carnero en una ciudad, \q ¿no tiembla la gente? \q Si llega el desastre a una ciudad, \q ¿no lo ha hecho {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}?
es.R: Cuando suena en la ciudad la trompeta de alarma, \q ¿no se asusta la gente? \q Cuando el desastre llega a una ciudad, \q ¿no es {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} quien lo ha enviado?

fr.L: Sonne-t-on du cor dans une ville \q sans que le peuple tremble ? \q Arrive-t-il un malheur dans une ville \q sans que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’ait fait ?
fr.B: Si l’on sonne du cor dans une ville, \q le peuple ne tremble-t-il pas ? \q Si un malheur frappe une ville, \q n’est-ce pas {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} qui l’a fait ?
fr.R: Quand la trompette d’alarme sonne dans une ville, \q les gens n’ont-ils pas peur ? \q Quand un malheur arrive dans une ville, \q n’est-ce pas {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} qui l’a envoyé ?

sw.L: Je, baragumu hupigwa mjini \q na watu wasitetemeke? \q Je, msiba huwapata mji \q na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asiwe ameutenda?
sw.B: Baragumu likipigwa mjini, \q je, watu hawatetemeki? \q Maafa yakiupata mji, \q je, si {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliyeyatenda?
sw.R: Baragumu la hatari linapolia mjini, \q je, watu hawaogopi? \q Maafa yanapoupata mji, \q je, si {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliyeyaleta?

vi.L: Kèn có thổi lên trong thành \q mà dân chúng lại không run sợ chăng? \q Có tai họa nào trong thành \q mà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} không làm [ra] chăng?
vi.B: Nếu tiếng tù và vang lên trong thành, \q dân chúng há chẳng run sợ sao? \q Nếu tai họa xảy đến cho một thành, \q há chẳng phải {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã làm sao?
vi.R: Khi tiếng kèn báo động vang lên trong thành, \q dân chúng há không sợ hãi sao? \q Khi tai họa xảy đến cho một thành, \q há chẳng phải chính {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã giáng tai họa ấy sao?

ko.L: 성읍에서 나팔이 울리는데 \q 백성이 떨지 않겠느냐? \q 성읍에 재앙이 닥쳤는데 \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 [그것을] 하지 않으셨겠느냐?
ko.B: 성읍에서 숫양 뿔 나팔이 울리면 \q 백성이 떨지 않겠느냐? \q 성읍에 재앙이 닥치면 \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하신 일이 아니겠느냐?
ko.R: 성읍에서 위험을 알리는 나팔이 울리면 \q 백성이 두려워하지 않겠느냐? \q 성읍에 재앙이 닥치면 \q 그것을 보내신 분이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 아니시겠느냐?

pt.L: Toca-se o chifre de carneiro numa cidade \q e o povo não treme? \q Há calamidade numa cidade \q e {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} não [a] fez?
pt.B: Se o chifre de carneiro toca numa cidade, \q o povo não treme? \q Se a desgraça vem sobre uma cidade, \q não foi {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} que a fez?
pt.R: Quando a trombeta de alarme toca numa cidade, \q o povo não fica com medo? \q Quando a desgraça vem sobre uma cidade, \q não foi {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} que a mandou?

am.L: መለከት በከተማ ይነፋልን፣ \q ሕዝቡም አይንቀጠቀጥምን? \q በከተማ ላይ ክፉ ነገር ይደርሳልን፣ \q {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ያላደረገው?
am.B: የቀንድ መለከት በከተማ ቢነፋ፣ \q ሕዝቡ አይንቀጠቀጥምን? \q በከተማ ላይ መከራ ቢደርስ፣ \q {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ያደረገው አይደለምን?
am.R: የማስጠንቀቂያ መለከት በከተማ ሲነፋ፣ \q ሕዝቡ አይፈራምን? \q በከተማ ላይ መከራ ሲደርስ፣ \q ያመጣው {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} አይደለምን?

hi.L: क्या किसी नगर में नरसिंगा फूँका जाता है \q और लोग नहीं काँपते? \q क्या किसी नगर पर विपत्ति आती है \q और {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने [उसे] नहीं किया?
hi.B: यदि किसी नगर में नरसिंगा फूँका जाए, \q तो क्या लोग नहीं काँपते? \q यदि किसी नगर पर विपत्ति आए, \q तो क्या {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने उसे नहीं किया?
hi.R: जब किसी नगर में चेतावनी का नरसिंगा बजता है, \q तो क्या लोग डर नहीं जाते? \q जब किसी नगर पर विपत्ति आती है, \q तो क्या {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने ही उसे नहीं भेजा?

ru.L: Разве трубят в трубу в городе, \q и народ не трепещет? \q Разве бывает бедствие в городе, \q и {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} не сделал [этого]?
ru.B: Если в городе трубят в рог, \q разве народ не трепещет? \q Если в город приходит беда, \q разве не {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} сделал это?
ru.R: Когда в городе трубят тревогу, \q разве люди не боятся? \q Когда в город приходит беда, \q разве не {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} послал её?

ja.L: 町でラッパが吹き鳴らされて、 \q 民がおののかないだろうか。 \q 町に災いが起こって、 \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}がなさったのでないだろうか。
ja.B: 町で角笛が吹き鳴らされたら、 \q 民はおののかないだろうか。 \q 町に災いが起これば、 \q それは{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}がなさったのではないだろうか。
ja.R: 町で危険を知らせるラッパが鳴れば、 \q 人々はおびえないだろうか。 \q 町に災いが起これば、 \q それを送られたのは{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}ではないだろうか。

uk.L: Чи засурмлять у сурму в місті, \q а народ не затремтить? \q Чи буде лихо в місті, \q а {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} не вчинив [його]?
uk.B: Якщо в місті засурмлять у ріг, \q хіба народ не затремтить? \q Якщо на місто прийде лихо, \q хіба не {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} це вчинив?
uk.R: Коли в місті лунає сурма тривоги, \q хіба люди не бояться? \q Коли на місто приходить лихо, \q хіба не {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} його послав?

decisions.choice: a trumpet blown in a city: the watchman's alarm that an enemy is coming
decisions.reason: A watchman blew the ram's horn to warn a city of attack (Jeremiah 6:1, 17; Ezekiel 33:3-6; Hosea 5:8). When it sounds, everyone trembles. Amos's words are such an alarm.

decisions.choice: calamity in a city that the LORD has not done: the disaster coming on Israel is the LORD's doing
decisions.reason: "Calamity" here is disaster, not moral evil, as in Isaiah 45:7. The question expects the answer that the LORD is behind it. Amos does not offer a general teaching about every misfortune; he insists that what is about to strike Israel, like the disasters of 4:6-11, comes from the LORD, and so it has a reason and calls for a response.

decisions.choice: trumpet (L, R), ram's horn (B); calamity (L), disaster (B, R)
decisions.reason: The ram's horn follows the settled wording: "trumpet" at Literal and Readable and "ram's horn" at Balanced. Readable adds "warning" to say what it was blown for (m1).

decisions.choice: calamidade (L); desgraça (B, R)
decisions.reason: The word means disaster here, not moral evil (m2); Portuguese "o mal" would suggest both, so the levels say "calamidade" and "desgraça".

decisions.choice: shofar "ラッパ" (L, R), "角笛" (B) as the English per level; ra'ah "災い"; the LORD's act with the light respect form "なさった / 送られた".
decisions.reason: The shofar convention of HOS-1 and the rule for God's acts in the third person.

en.L: For the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} does not do a thing \q unless {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has revealed {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} secret \q to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} servants the prophets.
en.B: The Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} does nothing at all \q unless {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} first reveals {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} plan \q to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} servants the prophets.
en.R: The Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} does nothing \q without first telling {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} plans \q to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} servants the prophets.

es.L: Porque el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}} no hará nada \q sin revelar {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} secreto \q a {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} siervos los profetas.
